summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, int64 coordinates) pairs with updated docstring; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter with channel-whole patch_size, ensure_tuple start_pos, NumpyPadMode mode; GridPatchDataset(dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True) with NumPy-ceiling worker split, NotImplementedError for missing len, per-patch apply_transform; PatchDataset docstring float fix); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds PatchIter autodoc; tests/test_grid_dataset.py with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_length_raises. Unverified: tests were not run, and the pinned 4-decimal patch values in test_loading_array may fail at rtol 1e-5. Line lengths were checked by grep only; black was not run. Decisions: missing-length error is raised in __iter__; the seed is set once in setUp only.
